decl: AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_kernelDescentUnit
docstring: "**The descent unit of a Čech class killed by the base change (ζ3 brick\
  \ W).**\nGiven a unit `0`-cochain `β` on a cover `\U0001D49C` of `X_B` refining\
  \ the pullback of `ℰ` and\ntrivializing the pulled-back cocycle of `lam` (hypothesis\
  \ `hβ`), there is a global unit\n`w` on `Spec (B ⊗[A] B)` such that\n\n* the pullback\
  \ of `w` to the curve product restricts, on the canonical common\n  refinement,\
  \ to the ratio of the two coprojection pullbacks of `β`; and\n* the `ΓSpecIso`-avatar\
  \ of `w` in `(B ⊗[A] B)ˣ` is a descent `1`-cocycle.\n\nThe gluing is the ζ2·P toolkit;\
  \ the Amitsur identity is checked upstairs along the\nsimplicial coincidences, where\
  \ the `β`-telescope cancels exactly; the diagonal\nnormalization is the whiskered\
  \ degeneracy."
